messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Monday, Friday, or is observed on a Monday when the statutory holiday falls on a weekend.  (Federal holidays that are observed only in certain provinces are noted.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Observed? | Province(s) | Long‑Weekend Effect |
|-------------|---------|-----------|-------------|---------------------|
| **Jan 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | Observed Mon Jan 2 | All | **Jan 1–3** (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Feb 20** (Monday) | Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan) | — | ON, MB, SK | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Feb 21** (Monday) | Family Day (Alberta, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island) | — | AB, NB, NL, NS, PE | **Feb 19–21** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Apr 7** (Friday) | Good Friday | — | All | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) |
| **May 22** (Monday) | Victoria Day | — | All | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Jul 1** (Saturday) | Canada Day | Observed Mon Jul 3 | All | **Jul 1–3** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4** (Monday) | Labour Day | — | All | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Oct 9** (Monday) | Thanksgiving | — | All | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Nov 11** (Saturday) | Remembrance Day | Observed Mon Nov 13 | All | **Nov 11–13** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) |
| **Dec 25** (Sunday) | Christmas Day | Observed Mon Dec 26 | All | **Dec 25–27** (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) |
| **Dec 26** (Monday) | Boxing Day | — | All | **Dec 26–27** (Mon‑Tue) |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Data source** – The dates above are derived from the federal holiday schedule for 2023. For province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day), you can store a mapping of provinces to holiday dates.
2. **Long‑weekend logic** – When a holiday falls on a Monday or Friday, automatically flag the adjacent weekend days as part of a long weekend. If the holiday falls on a weekend, use the “observed” date (usually the following Monday) to create the long weekend.
3. **UI display** – Show the holiday name, the actual date, the observed date (if applicable), and the province(s) it applies to. Highlight the long‑weekend block in your calendar view.

Feel free to let me know if you need the same information for another year or for a specific province!
